---
title: coord-cartesian
subtitle: Cartesian coordinate system with optional panel clipping.
category: Coord
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


Clipping via `xlim`/`ylim` preserves the trained scales; rows outside
are still used for training but drawn off-panel.

## Usage

```typst
coord-cartesian(
  xlim: none,
  ylim: none,
  expand: true,
)
```


## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `xlim` | `none` | Pair `(lo, hi)` clipping the drawn x range, or `none`. |
| `ylim` | `none` | Pair `(lo, hi)` clipping the drawn y range, or `none`. |
| `expand` | `true` | Whether to add a small margin around the data range. |

## Returns

Coordinate dictionary consumed by [`plot`](../core/plot.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/coord-cartesian-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = range(0, 20).map(i => (x: i, y: i * 0.5))
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y"),
  layers: (geom-point(size: 2pt),),
  coord: coord-cartesian(xlim: (2, 15), ylim: (0, 8)),
)
```
